rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The statement dated 13 July 1991 says 2,244 delegates met in the 48th National Conference from 2 to 7 July 1991, that the conference elected a new NEC by secret ballot under an independent electoral commission, and that 'Oliver Tambo and Nelson Mandela were unanimously elected National Chairman and President respectively'; the other four top officials are Walter Sisulu (Deputy President), Cyril Ramaphosa, Jacob Zuma and Thomas Nkobi.

locator.section: First paragraph (conference dates); penultimate section on the election of the NEC; closing 'Issued by ... 13 July, 1991'

rows.role_title: National Chairman of the African National Congress
rows.text: The same statement reports that Oliver Tambo was unanimously elected National Chairman at the conference.

locator.section: Penultimate section on the election of the NEC
